commonTropes.name: Contract Marriage Codicil
commonTropes.description: A fake marriage required to secure a corporate inheritance.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The fake bride holds the core patent needed to save the groom's company.
commonTropes.emotionalPayoff: Romantic power balance shift and satisfying revenge.

commonTropes.name: Forbidden Identity
commonTropes.description: Falling in love with a rival dynasty's hidden heir.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: Both lovers know each other's secrets from day one.

commonTropes.name: The Unreliable Confession
commonTropes.description: A caller claiming to be a killer from a cold case.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The caller is not the killer, but the victim's forgotten twin exposing police corruption.

commonTropes.name: Paranoid Mirror
commonTropes.description: A therapist discovering their patient is detailing the therapist's own forgotten past.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The patient is actually a simulation created by the therapist to recover lost memories.

commonTropes.name: Forbidden Neural Chip
commonTropes.description: An illegal memory drive containing corporate/sovereign secrets.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The memory drive belongs to the city's ruler, revealing he was once a human resident of the slums.
commonTropes.emotionalPayoff: Awe, existential intrigue, and underdog empowerment.

commonTropes.name: High-Tech Low-Life
commonTropes.description: Advanced cybernetics amidst crumbling neon slums.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The slum technicians possess better raw ingenuity than corporate engineers.

commonTropes.name: The Rejected Lineage
commonTropes.description: An outcast cast aside by a ruthless lord.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: Her dormant lineage connects directly to the ancient High Sovereign.
commonTropes.emotionalPayoff: Ultimate emotional vindication and royal ascendance.

commonTropes.name: Forbidden Elemental Rune
commonTropes.description: Unlocking forbidden magic sealed for centuries.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The rune requires harmony between light and void rather than pure light.

commonTropes.name: The Sealed Cipher
commonTropes.description: Decoding a renaissance manuscript connected to modern murders.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The cipher exposes a secret royal heir living as a clockmaker.

commonTropes.name: Mercenary Extraction
commonTropes.description: Rescuing a whistleblower from a fortress.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The whistleblower is an AI core that hired the mercenaries directly.

commonTropes.name: Paranormal Audio Signal
commonTropes.description: A radio station intercepting eerie ghost broadcasts.
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The radio station is broadcasting from the afterlife into the living world.
commonTropes.emotionalPayoff: Cosmic dread and terrifying atmospheric thrill.

commonTropes.name: Court Intrigue Cipher
commonTropes.subversionAngle: The queen herself authored the cipher to sabotage her corrupt council.
